label: Twofold cost of sex
statement_en: An asexual mutant female in a sexual population with equal sex ratio produces twice as many grandchildren as a sexual female, so sex needs a compensating advantage of up to twofold to persist.

lean.source:
/-- **Twofold cost of sex.** With equal fecundity and a `1 : 1` sex ratio, the odds of asexual to
sexual females double every generation. Fecundity cancels. -/
theorem twofold_cost_of_sex {q f : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hf : 0 < f) :
    odds (asexualNext q f) = 2 * odds q := by
  have h1q : 0 < 1 - q := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < q * f + (1 - q) * f / 2 := by positivity
  unfold odds asexualNext
  have hne : 1 - q * f / (q * f + (1 - q) * f / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]
    intro h
    rw [eq_div_iff hden.ne'] at h
    have : 0 < (1 - q) * f / 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  rw [div_eq_iff hne]
  field_simp
  ring

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate that commits to a spread faster or slower than the twofold doubling under the stated assumptions
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C5, the twofold cost.** A candidate that commits the asexual fraction to `q` now and `qn` after `n`
generations, under equal fecundity and a 1:1 sex ratio, with `odds qn ≠ 2^n · odds q`, is ruled out. -/
theorem twofold_rules_out {q f : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hf : 0 < f) (n : ℕ) {qn : ℝ}
    (hqn : asexualAfter q f n = qn) (h : odds qn ≠ 2 ^ n * odds q) : False := by
  have := twofold_cost_of_sex_n hq0 hq1 hf n
  rw [hqn] at this
  exact h this

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate that commits to a per-generation odds factor other than 2 under the stated assumptions; a factor of 2 is the theorem and is consistent
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C5b, the per-generation factor.** Under equal fecundity and a 1:1 sex ratio the odds of asexual
females grow by exactly `2` per generation: a candidate committing to any other factor is ruled out. -/
theorem twofold_factor_rules_out {q f r : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hf : 0 < f)
    (hr : odds (asexualNext q f) = r * odds q) (h : r ≠ 2) : False := by
  have h2 := twofold_cost_of_sex hq0 hq1 hf
  have hodds : 0 < odds q := div_pos hq0 (by linarith)
  rw [h2] at hr
  exact h (mul_right_cancel₀ hodds.ne' hr).symm
